faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 24th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 80,000. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.E./M.S. in relevant engineering fields, and a PhD in a related domain. Additionally, a minimum of two research articles as the first author in SCI-indexed journals are mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF) position announced by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: The primary selection process involves an application screening. Shortlisted candidates will be further notified.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Roorkee offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q9. What specific areas of research are preferred for the PhD?
faq.answer: The PhD should be in Manufacturing/Production/Materials or a closely related domain, with specific work experience in areas like laser material processing, surface engineering, micro/nano fabrication, or advanced manufacturing.
